title: Buck and marijuana: the police raid in Toronto
summary: Buck had taken up marijuana with musician friends; at his Toronto hotel the police arrived while Bubbles was visiting to learn a song.

story.theme_name: Drink, drugs and the bandstand's casualties
story.community_name: Drugs and drink on the bandstand and the road

blocks.x: However, I passed that stage and I come on into another movement of where I've got to get out of New York again. I didn't like it. They didn't want to pay the salary, that was it. They didn't want to pay the salary.

Now getting $1,000 a week -- $150 is like $1,000 a week and they wanted to drop the price down to $500 and Buck gets into a little difficulty hanging out with all the musicians. He learned how to smoke marijuana and I couldn't slow him down and he got to hanging out with the musicians and so forth and they had a very sad reputation in Canada. And we were going to go back to Canada to play again and while we're back in Canada to play again we get a job at Basil's, I think the name of the place is Basil's. Basil's Restaurant and I get an apartment in Toronto and my partner goes to a hotel. And his boys, musician friends come to see him and he'd hang out with them and they'd come to his hotel and get high and transform marijuana to each other while they had it and I go to his house after the opening show at Basil's Restaurant, I go to his house, hotel, to learn a song that I wanted to learn and I get to his hotel that night and would you believe that some of his friends which he had called and he had them there

and the fella onthe desk downstairs called up to tell him the police was coming. And I don't nobody , no police, I don't know these guys what they were doing, I didn't know what they were doing. But I'm up there and the police came and says -- they didn't want to open the door and I told them to open that door, Buck, open the door. And Buck was running around trying to hide all this.

Anyway, the police came in, took everybody down. They searched my car and they searched Buck's room. They didn't seem to find anything there but later they must have found something because when they took us down -- now I'm at the apartment house, I'm in a different neighborhood altogether. The difference of the paths of moving was night and day from where they were to where they had to come for me. From where they got them to where I was come from to there, they knew I didn't belong in that lot.
